definitions.short: a craggy rock , literally or figuratively (a fortress )
definitions.full: H5553. sela I. סֶ֫לַע 61 noun masculine Judg 6:20 crag, cliff , synonym צוּר ; — absolute ׳ס 6:20 +, סָ֑לַע Num 20:10 +; construct סֶ֫לַע 1Sam 23:28 ; suffix סַלְעִי 2Sam 22:2 +, סַלְעוֺ Isa 31:9 ; plural סְלָעִים 2:21 +; — 1 literally cliff, crag Judg 6:20 ; Isa 2:21 ; 7:19 ; Amos 6:12 ; Num 20:8 (twice in verse); 20:10 (twice in verse); 20:11 (compare Neh 9:15 ; Psa 78:16 , and contrast the צוּר of Exod 17:6 ), Num 24:21 ; Deut 32:13 (not elsewhere Hexateuch), + 10 t.; הַסּ ׳שֵׁן 1Sam 14:4 (twice in verse) tooth of the crag , i.e. sharp crag, so Job 39:28 ; excavated in cliff as place of burial Isa 22:16 ; abode of wild animals, ׳יַעֲלֵיסֿ 22:1 , compare Psa 104:18 ; Prov 30:26 , of birds Job 39:28 ; Song 2:14 (in figurative), compare Jer 48:28 , so of Edom Obadiah 3 = 49:16 ; compare ( Num 24:21 above and) Isa 42:11 ; particular cliffs are: ׳ס עֵיטָם Judg 15:8 , 11 compare 15:13 , ׳ס (הָ)רִמּוֺן 20:45 , 47 (twice in verse); 21:13 ׳ס הַמַּחְלְקוֺת 1Sam 23:28 compare 23:25 ; see also II. סֶלַע . 2 figurative, especially סַלְעִי of ׳י (only Psalms), Psa 18:3 = 2Sam 22:2 ; Psa 31:4 ; 42:10 ; 71:3 ; of Assyrian god Isa 31:9 (probably; compare צוּר Deut 32:31 , 37 ); ס ׳צֵל כָּבֵד Isa 32:2 (simile of protecting care); figurative of security Psa 40:3 (feet on cliff), מִשְׂגַּבּוֺ סְלָעִים מְצָדוֺת Isa 33:16 ; symbol of obstinacy מִסּ פְנֵיהֶם ׳חִזְּקוּ Jer 5:3 ; ס ׳צְחִיחַ ( bare cliff , literally glare of [ the ] cliff ), in figure of openness, flagrancy Ezek 24:7-8 , of razed city 26:4 , 14 (only here Ezekiel); in figure of fall of Babylonian Jer 51:25 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to be lofty ;
